name: Stella
built: A mobile manifestation and affirmation app sold on subscription through the App Store.
results: $300K MRR and about 12,000 paying customers roughly two months after launch (founder interview, mid-2026).
steal: Pick a self-improvement habit people already pay coaches for, then ask Claude Code to scaffold a paywalled daily-ritual app: onboarding quiz → personalised plan → one guided action per day. Ship the paywall on day one and let the onboarding quiz do the selling.

name: fly.pieter.com
built: A free browser flight-simulator MMO that earns money by selling in-game ad placements (planes, blimps, billboards) as monthly subscriptions.
results: $87,000 MRR (≈$1M ARR) 17 days after launch, self-reported on X in March 2025.
steal: Build in public and let attention become inventory: ship a free, shareable toy, post progress daily, and monetise the audience with sponsor slots inside the product instead of charging players. Prompt the AI editor feature-by-feature in one file rather than asking for the whole game at once.

name: CalBuddy
built: A localised AI calorie-tracking app for the Israeli market, modelled on the Cal AI concept.
results: Over $80K/month in revenue about 12 months after its June 2025 launch (Starter Story interview).
steal: Find a proven global app that is weak in your language or country and rebuild it locally: native language, local foods/brands, local payment methods. Feed the AI screenshots of the original flow and ask for a localised clone of each screen.

name: Lumoo
built: A B2B platform that generates AI fashion imagery and virtual try-on content for clothing brands.
results: €700K ARR nine months after launch, per Lovable's customer story (Oct 2025). Note: published by the tool vendor.
steal: Domain experts win: if you know an industry's expensive manual task (here, product photoshoots), prototype the replacement in Lovable, put it in front of buyers you already know, and charge B2B prices from the first customer.

name: GeoSports
built: A daily sports-geography guessing game played in the browser, in the Wordle/GeoGuessr mould.
results: Over $40K per month roughly three months after launch (Starter Story, 2026).
steal: Daily-puzzle format + a passionate niche = built-in retention and shareability. Ask Claude for a single-page game with one puzzle per day, a shareable emoji result grid, and a streak counter; seed the first 30 puzzles yourself.

name: Plinq
built: A women's-safety app in Brazil that lets users check a person's public criminal-record history before meeting them.
results: 10K+ users and R$2.2M (~$456K) ARR about three months after launch, per Lovable's customer story (Sept 2025). Note: published by the tool vendor.
steal: Wrap public data in a product people urgently need. A non-developer built front end, back end and workflows in Lovable; distribution came from the founders' marketing skill (viral posts, TikTok). Plan the launch content as carefully as the app.

name: Profit AI
built: A Shopify app for profit analytics and marketing automation, grown out of a spreadsheet the founder used with clients.
results: $30K MRR for the app and $147K total revenue since its December 2025 launch (Starter Story, June 2026).
steal: Productise the spreadsheet your service clients already rely on. Give the AI your sheet's formulas and ask for a Shopify-connected dashboard reproducing them; sell it first to existing service clients.

name: Pep AI
built: A consumer mobile app built with Replit's agent and Claude.
results: 10,000 users and $30K revenue in its first month after launch (Starter Story, 2026).
steal: Time-box the build to a month and spend the rest on distribution. Use Replit Agent to get a working subscription app live fast, then iterate only on what first-week users actually touch.

name: ToneAdapt
built: A web and mobile app that helps guitarists recreate the tones of famous songs on their own gear.
results: Over $25K combined web + mobile revenue in the past four weeks, five months after launch (Starter Story, 2026).
steal: Turn your hobby's most-asked forum question into an app. Prompt: 'Given a song and the user's amp/pedals, output exact settings', then ship web first and wrap it as a mobile app once people pay.

name: LaunchFast
built: An AI product-research tool for Amazon sellers, distributed through a partnership with a seller-coaching company.
results: $20K+ MRR about 90 days after launch (founder, Starter Story).
steal: Build for an audience someone else already owns: make a narrow tool a coaching business can bundle for its students, then pitch them a revenue share instead of buying ads.

name: Cat on Chair
built: A simple, cute Pomodoro focus-timer app with a cat theme.
results: Over $18K in sales in the 30 days from 13 April 2026 (Starter Story).
steal: Commodity utility + strong personality. Take a solved category (timers, to-dos), give it a charming character and aesthetic, and let the design carry the marketing on TikTok and Instagram.

name: Maxed AI
built: An AI gym and fitness coaching app for iOS.
results: About $14K revenue in the last 28 days, roughly six months after launch (Starter Story, Oct 2026).
steal: Keep the core loop tiny: log workout → AI suggests next session. Ask Claude Code for one screen at a time and resist adding features until retention data says so.

name: STOPPR
built: A mobile app that helps people quit sugar cravings, positioned as a twist on existing quit-habit apps.
results: $12K/month five months after launch, built with no coding background (Starter Story, Oct 2025).
steal: '1% different' playbook: find a successful habit app, keep its proven onboarding and paywall pattern, and retarget it at an adjacent habit with its own community.

name: Vugola
built: An AI video-editing SaaS (clipping and editing for creators), started in Lovable and later moved to Claude and Codex.
results: Over $10K per month, built by a 19-year-old without prior coding experience (Starter Story, Oct 2026).
steal: Start in a visual builder to validate, then graduate to a coding agent when the product outgrows it. Don't be precious about the stack, be precious about shipping weekly.

name: Coherence
results: Around $85K total revenue and 15,000+ downloads in the first eight months after its February 2025 launch (Starter Story).
steal: Wellness apps with a single clear ritual sell well. Have the AI generate the animation/timer engine once, then spend your time on content (sessions) rather than code.

name: Payout
built: A mobile app that finds class-action settlements US consumers may be owed and helps them claim, sold as a weekly/annual subscription.
results: Won RevenueCat's Shipaton 2025 grand prize; reported $1,003,227 ARR ($83.6K MRR) in May 2026 per a case compilation of the founder's posts.
steal: Prepare the data model and UI screenshots before prompting, then let Claude write full screens from them. Pair the build with a distribution partner (here, a creator with a huge following given equity).
